newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones ends weaker after whipsaw session.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones ends weaker after whipsaw session.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average closed sharply lower Friday after being whipsawed by a series of computerized program trades that first sent the index plunging about 90 points and then nearly wiping out all of the losses.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended down 59.27 points, or 0.88 percent, at 6,696.48. On Thursday, it rose rose through the 6,900 level for the first time before ending 94 points lower. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 16-8 on heavy volume of 546 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
